directive: JAYT-136R — SEMANTIC FALSE-POSITIVE CONTAINMENT & CLAIM-BINDING REBUILD
executive_ruling: Independent CEO audit revealed that semantic parser 136 falsely promoted 16 items to ACTIVE_VERIFIED based on keyword fragments from headers, legal footers, and synthesized strings. All 16 claims demoted to UNREVIEWED_RAW_CAPTURE.

root_causes.description: Parser matched disjoint generic words (ưu đãi, ngày, sinh viên) across headers, footers, and legal disclaimers, falsely promoting general venue and legal pages into ACTIVE_VERIFIED.
Parser synthesized strings for validity (Chính sách niên khóa) and locality (Cổng sinh viên toàn quốc) that were not present in raw source DOM.
Parser captured addresses from non-Da Nang branches (e.g. Jollibee Mỹ Tho) as valid locality evidence.
Active runner run_batch_capture_135.js was left in active directory; now fully quarantined.
